limitations: The month split is enforced for fitting and selection, but September has already been examined in earlier studies, so it is not an untouched prospective test. Many overlapping minutes are not independent trials; one stock and22fitting sessions give limited regime diversity. Compare per-side ranking and calibration against frozen base rates and report sparse counts. Do not retune after evaluating September.
score_semantics: Absolute score is estimated TP probability; sign is direction; tie is abstention.
